name_story.story: Hakki can be understood through the Arabic form حَقِّي, whose central sense is hakki; of truth (relative form). Hakki is the Turkish form of Arabic حَقِّيّ (Ḥaqqī), the relative form of حَقّ (truth), used as a male given name.

faq.a: Hakki is associated with the Arabic form حَقِّي, whose core sense is hakki; of truth (relative form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Hakki?
faq.a: Hakki is associated with Arabic. Hakki is the Turkish form of Arabic حَقِّيّ (Ḥaqqī), the relative form of حَقّ (truth), used as a male given name.
Yes — the underlying form حَقِّي is Arabic.
Hakki can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Hakki should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Ḥaqqī is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Hakki mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Hakki is rendered حقی and carries the sense حقی، حق سے منسوب.

faq.q: What does Hakki mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Hakki is rendered حقی and carries the sense حقی، منسوب به حق.
A romanized syllable approximation is hak-ki. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Hakki?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Hakki, hakki. Script forms are حقي, حقی, حَقِّي, हक़्क़ी.

faq.q: Is Hakki a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
